pro_space.setup_title: Set up your space in 2 minutes

pro_space.trial_banner: Free trial running: it ends on {date}. Cancel before then and nothing is charged.

pro_space.locked_comparator: Soon: the odds of licensed bookmakers for today's bets, the best first.
pro_space.locked_strategy: Your settings for the programme: our strategy, being tested on new matches, or your own choices.

pro_space.guard_ok: All good: you're under today's limit.
pro_space.bets_sub: Your bets, logged here. Only yours.

pro_space.strategy_ours_text: In test on new matches, no gain proven yet. It's the strategy IASHARK recommends.

pro_space.guard_count_both: Count: {journal} in your bet log and {telegram} in Telegram today (Paris time).

pro_onboarding.title: Set up your Pro space
pro_onboarding.sub: {n} questions, 2 minutes. You can change everything later in your account.
pro_onboarding.edit_sub: Change what you like: your settings are saved to your account.

pro_onboarding.guard_help: A daily bet limit you set yourself. Your dashboard warns you when you reach it. In Telegram (soon), the bot stops for the day once you have logged that many tickets there.
pro_onboarding.guard_capital_help: Optional. It stays private and is not shown anywhere in your space.
pro_onboarding.alert_seuil: The odds drop below the minimum
pro_onboarding.alert_hausse: The odds of your bet go up

pro_onboarding.err_save: Couldn't save right now. Try again in a moment.
pro_onboarding.err_login: Log in to set up your Pro space.

pro_onboarding.bookmakers_none_ticked: None ticked = all of those listed.

pro_onboarding.alerts_help: They'll arrive in your Telegram bot (soon).
pro_onboarding.alert_compositions: The line-up is out (1 hour before)
pro_onboarding.alert_nuit_help: Without this box, nothing between 11 pm and 8 am (Paris time).
pro_onboarding.telegram_help: The Telegram bot is coming soon: your settings will be ready.
pro_onboarding.telegram_yes_text: Every day, the programme's bets with the best odds at your bookmakers.

pro_trial.title: How the trial works
pro_trial.line1: Nothing to pay today. Your card is required, but nothing is charged for 7 days.
pro_trial.line2: An email reminds you 2 days before the trial ends.
pro_trial.line3: Cancel in 1 click in your account, at any time. During the trial, you pay nothing.
pro_trial.line4: If you don't cancel, the subscription starts when the trial ends, at the price of the length you chose.
pro_trial.once: Trial for a first subscription only.
pro_trial.cancel_done_trial: Cancelled. You keep Pro until {date}, and nothing will be charged.
pro_trial.cancel_done: Cancelled. You keep Pro until {date}, then the subscription stops.
pro_trial.cancel_error: The cancellation didn't go through. Try again, or use “Manage my subscription”.
pro_trial.success_setup: Set up your Pro space: your country, your bookmakers, your limits. 2 minutes.
pro_trial.success_title_trial: Trial activated, nothing has been charged
pro_trial.cancel_email_sent: A confirmation email has been sent to you.
pro_trial.cancel_email_failed: The confirmation email could not be sent right now. Keep this message: it shows your end date.
pro_trial.headline: {days} days free, then {prices}, cancel in 1 click
pro_trial.until_detail: Nothing is charged before then. Unless you cancel, the first payment is taken on {date}.
